name: Ear
overview: The Scriptures reveal the ear as a significant symbol in both physical and spiritual consecration. In the consecration of priests, blood is applied to the tip of the right ear, signifying dedication to God's service (Exodus 29:20; Leviticus 8:23). Similarly, in the ritual cleansing of lepers, blood and anointing oil are placed on the ear, underscoring purification and restoration (Leviticus 14:14,17). The piercing or boring of the ear, as in Exodus 21:6, represents a voluntary and permanent servitude, illustrating submission and commitment. These literal practices also carry figurative and anthropomorphic meanings, pointing to the ear as a symbol of obedience and attentiveness to God's commands.
